summary: Verified Enterprise Reality Validation Guardian noise-suppression fix in /app/backend/scheduler.py. Static code checks confirm: (a) 15-min startup grace period with early return + INFO log, (b) no notify_autoheal variable anywhere in scheduler.py, (c) notify_breach + notify_recovery still send via send_catalog_template(template_key='automation_alert'), (d) self-heal-within-cycle branch is logger.info-only (no email send), audit insert into enterprise_autonomous_engine_audit preserved, (e) last_alert_at only mutated inside notify_breach/notify_recovery blocks. Runtime verification: backend restarted cleanly, APScheduler started, guardian job 'enterprise_reality_validation_guardian' is registered, and the grace-period log fired as expected at ~150s after start ('[enterprise-guardian] startup grace period active — skipping validation cycle'). No enterprise-guardian automation_alert emails were emitted during grace period. Decision-logic simulation covers all 6 scenarios (self-heal→no email, breach→email, recovery→email, healthy-no-action→no email, degraded-within-cooldown→no email, degraded-after-cooldown→re-emit). Regression: /api/health 200, admin cookie-based login OK (is_admin=true), /api/autonomous-engine/status 200 dict body. 17/17 pytest cases pass.

minor.issue: Pre-existing MongoDB IndexOptionsConflict on expires_at_1 and session_token_1 at startup (server.py:2914, db_security_hardening:61) and '[db-hardening] startup pass failed: modify immutable field _id' (server.py:2926). Unrelated to this fix — noted for main agent as separate cleanup.
Redis rate-limiter cannot connect to 127.0.0.1:6379 (api_rate_limiter:136). Pre-existing environment issue, unrelated to guardian fix.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal, targeted, and correct: notify_autoheal removed, grace-period early return added at top of guardian, self-heal branch is log-only, audit persistence intact.

Guardian body is ~350 lines nested inside a larger scheduler.py (4496 lines). Recommend main agent split scheduler.py into scheduler_jobs/ modules in a future refactor — current file is well above the 700-line threshold.

The 30 historical self-heal audit rows in enterprise_autonomous_engine_audit that previously triggered mystery emails should ideally be back-annotated with a 'legacy_noisy_alert=true' flag or left as-is with a comment — cosmetic only, not blocking.
Optional hardening: consider making the 15-min grace window a named constant (GUARDIAN_STARTUP_GRACE_SECONDS = 15 * 60) for readability and future tuning.

rca of the issue: Root cause (pre-fix): guardian ran every 5 min; transient heartbeat staleness after any backend restart (e.g., zero_trust_auto_mitigation) was auto-recovered in one cycle, but the code path still emitted notify_autoheal → send_catalog_template(template_key='automation_alert') to all admins. Result: 30 audit rows in enterprise_autonomous_engine_audit each accompanied by a '[RECOVERED] Enterprise Autonomous Engine — guardian_status=healthy / fix=triggered_zero_trust_auto_mitigation' email. Mitigation applied by main agent (verified here): (1) 15-min startup grace-period early return in scheduled_enterprise_reality_validation_guardian; (2) removed notify_autoheal entirely; (3) self-heal-within-cycle path now only logger.info + audit insert; (4) email branches restricted to true breach (healthy→degraded) and true recovery (degraded→healthy). Verified: grace-period log observed live; no notify_autoheal residue anywhere; audit insert untouched; last_alert_at only updates on real breach/recovery.
